headline: Bitcoin Holds Near 84k as Spot Funds Shed  Million and Greed Runs Ahead of a Flat Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost .07 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost .77 million, and solana funds lost .8 million, while bitcoin trades near 84k, down 0.31%. Fear and greed sits at 57, labeled greed, against a cycle index that is flat at 55, so the mood is warmer than the cash still leaving the listed funds. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015 with shorts crowded, the dollar is firm at 102.41, and volatility is compressed, with the VIX at 15.21 and seven-day realized volatility at 19.05 against 48.87 over thirty days.
author: jordan
